05 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
worth knowing.

A little preparation makes the first conversation more useful.

Ask us on Zalo
01What information helps define the box structure?＋

Share product length, width, height, weight, estimated quantity and packing method. Explain whether the box is for display, individual delivery or use inside an outer shipper so we can discuss a suitable structure.

02Can flute type and thickness be chosen from a photograph?＋

Photographs show appearance and printed surfaces, but cannot establish flute type or load capacity. HotPrint needs to discuss the product, materials and intended use before confirming specifications.

03What if my product is fragile or has several components?＋

Describe the contents, vulnerable points and delivery journey. Discuss dividers, inserts, outer shipping boxes and checks using a physical sample.

04Can I review structural and printed samples first?＋

Request a sample to examine fit, opening and printed presentation. Sample type, cost, quantity and preparation time are agreed directly.

05What should I prepare for colour matching?＋

Share logos, content, artwork if available and a colour reference. Materials and finishing can affect colour appearance, so agree on a reference sample before production.

06How are minimum quantity, price and timing determined?＋

HotPrint quotes individually after reviewing dimensions, structure, materials, printing and quantity. No single price, minimum quantity or timeline applies to every sample.
